prompt: Your sibling borrowed your bike and brought it back with a flat tyre, saying nothing about it until you find it the next morning. What is the most constructive first response?

options.text: Borrow something of theirs and return it damaged in the same way
Calmly point out the flat, ask what happened, and agree together how it will be repaired
Refuse to speak to them until they guess why you are annoyed
Fix it yourself and never lend anyone anything again

explanation: Naming the problem calmly and agreeing a repair shares responsibility fairly instead of turning a careless moment into a lasting grudge.
